label: AVM GmbH G-95SP GPON SFP ONT
description: mini-GPON ONT in an SFP module (Lantiq PEB98035, Linux (kernel 3.10.4, AVM firmware `SFP_7.5.13`)) that presents to the host as 1G Ethernet; GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up on sc-apc with no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over no published management.
